metadata.description: Knowledge base context for Context Rift module

entities.name: Context Manager
entities.description: Manages the occurrence and distribution of context tokens across separate connections.
entities.definition: A system component responsible for initializing and maintaining context state.

entities.name: Token Dispatcher
entities.description: Receives and processes permission tokens for successful context distribution.
entities.definition: Handles token routing and referred entity lookups.

entities.name: State Validator
entities.description: Validates the existence of initialized state before allowing connection.
entities.definition: Ensures state consistency across distributed occurrences.
